questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.topic: A phishing message and the signals in it
questions.learningObjective: Recognise a phishing signal in offers

stimulus.body: Email: 'You have won a £500 voucher. Claim now by entering your bank details.' No prior entry or contest.

questions.stem: In an architect's brief, the email above is reviewed; what signal is present?

options.text: An unsolicited prize demanding financial details

questions.explanation: An unsolicited prize demanding bank details is a phishing signal. Prize size, all-vouchers and all-email are wrong.
questions.hint: Ask what the email demands and whether it was solicited.

questions.stem: In an architect's brief, an engineer needs to send confidential files from an airport; what is the safest option?

options.text: Use a personal hotspot or VPN
